# A02-S09: Project budget

Correspondence extract. Omissions are marked […].

[…]

I have read your presentation. It is spot on regarding provocation, Art, Tech.

I would like to see a detailed budget for all the measures you mention in the presentation, as I can see from your contract proposal that a large part of the project is not included in the fee.
I see the project as a provocative art project and am of the opinion that this is what we have talked about. This is not a consulting job.

[…]

Our Art Residency at 25.000 kr./month is paid as a fee (B-income). We see Art Residency as an opportunity for young and upcoming artists/thinkers/provocateurs to create a work of art and convey their thoughts and ideas. It is also your opportunity to get broad exposure and profile your name and skills. Your art project is set at 150.000 kr. […]

[…]

We'll talk tomorrow. I am positive about the art project, but I can see that we need to create a common understanding.

[…]
